page.layout: One column of running text, with the running head above it and the page number at top right. Below the text: the signature "K 3" at lower left and the catchword "Præ-" at lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: ergo, donec contrarium firmioribus rati-onibus probetur, & in hoc casu & in cæ-teris ubi vigent dolus, metus, tyrannis & similia; virum bonum aut non [?]isse jūrāre (quod durum videtur summo n vitæ discrimine, si res ipsa non sit illi-cita) aut debere quod juravit religiosè observare. Atque hactenus de Jura-menti causa Efficiente. In quâ pertra-[?]tandâ volueraм esse brevior, sed res ion tulit. Excrevit stylus dum ista me-ditor longius quàm expectabam; & ta-men non pauca quæ possent utiliter dici, um brevitati consulo, prudens præter-[?]missi.

page.notes: Left edge of the scan is cut off, so the first letters of several lines are missing or partly visible (e.g. "ergo", "onibus", "teris", "n vitæ", "ion tulit", "um brevitati"). I have restored only what the visible letters support. "[?]isse" at the start of the line "non debuisse" is partly hidden. "pertra-" / "[?]tandâ": the hyphen and the missing first letter of the next line are unclear; the probable word is "pertractandâ". "voluera m" is printed with a gap; read as "volueram" with a doubtful letter. "[?]missi." is partly cut off at the left edge. The word "jūrāre" carries a macron as printed. The small marks (asterisks, dots) near the bottom of the text are ornaments or stains, not text, and are left out. The printed "s" is transcribed as "s" throughout.
